# NOTES — Front-end scaffolding (F3 plumbing)

Interactive artifact **«Modelo FV Montecristi → GPM»** — app shell, design tokens,
build pipeline to a claude.ai Artifact fragment, edition split (interno/externo),
theme, deterministic es-EC formatting. No views, no charts, no model data (F4+).

Built 2026-09-08 with the `web-artifacts-builder` skill (`init-artifact.sh` →
`bundle-artifact.sh`), then adapted as documented in **Deviations**.

## Stack (as generated by the skill's init script)

| Piece | Version | Note |
|---|---|---|
| React / react-dom | 19.2.8 | init script pulls latest `create-vite react-ts` → React 19, not 18 (see Deviations) |
| TypeScript | 6.0.2 | `strict`, `verbatimModuleSyntax`, `erasableSyntaxOnly`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` |
| Vite | 8.2.2 | dev server + `npm run build` (type-check + build to `dist-vite/`) |
| Tailwind CSS | 3.4.1 | wired to CSS tokens; `darkMode: ["variant", …]` (system + `data-theme`) |
| shadcn/ui | tarball | kept only: badge, button, command, dialog, popover, select, sheet, slider, tabs, tooltip |
| Parcel | 2.16.4 | artifact bundler (skill's `bundle-artifact.sh`) + `html-inline` → `bundle.html` |
| d3-scale / d3-shape / d3-array (+ @types) | 4.0.2 / 3.2.0 / 3.2.4 | installed for F4, **not used yet** |
| parse5 (dev) | 7.3.0 | fragment converter |
| tsx (dev) | 4.23 | runs `test/format.test.ts` |

Package manager: **pnpm** (the skill scripts call `pnpm`); `npm run <script>` works too.

## Results

### Bundle / fragment sizes (both editions, 2026-09-08)

| Edition | `bundle.html` (Parcel + html-inline) | `dist/fragment.html` | Target |
|---|---|---|---|
| interno | 357 872 bytes (349.5 KB) | 357 937 bytes (349.5 KB) | < 1 500 000 → **OK** (≈ 24 %) |
| externo | 357 857 bytes (349.5 KB) | 357 922 bytes (349.5 KB) | < 1 500 000 → **OK** |

Fragment contents (in order): `<title>` · one `<link>` to Google Fonts · 1 `<style>`
(28.98 KB CSS) · `<div id="root">` · 1 inline `<script type="module">`.
Vite build for reference: 326.7 KB JS + 29.6 KB CSS (105 KB / 6.4 KB gzip).

### CSP check — **passed** (both editions)

`scripts/to-fragment.mjs` parses the bundle (parse5) and fails if any structural
`src=` / `href=` / `srcset=` / `poster=` / `data=` / `action=` attribute, or any
`url()` / `@import` inside `<style>`, points to a host other than
`fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com`, or if any `<script src>` survives.
Result: only `fonts.googleapis.com` (the injected font `<link>`). Informational:
the JS mentions `react.dev` and `www.w3.org` as strings (React error URLs, SVG
namespace) — not resource loads. Report: `dist/fragment.report.json`
(copied to `out/<edition>/`).

### Exclusion check — **passed**

```
✔ interno bundle.html   INTERNO_MARKER_9F2A ×1 (must appear)   · edition declared: yes
✔ interno fragment.html INTERNO_MARKER_9F2A ×1
✔ externo bundle.html   INTERNO_MARKER_9F2A ×0 (must not appear) · edition declared: yes
✔ externo fragment.html INTERNO_MARKER_9F2A ×0
```

The Vite (Rollup) build behaves the same: `grep -c INTERNO_MARKER_9F2A dist-vite/assets/*.js`
→ 1 (interno) / 0 (externo). In the externo bundle the JSX attribute compiles to
`"data-internal-marker":void 0` — the module is gone, not just the string.

### Format tests — **73/73 pass** (`npm run test:format`)

### Headless smoke (`npm run smoke`, optional) — 20/20 checks per edition

Hash routing (`#v=…&c=…`), nav clicks, ⌘K/Ctrl K palette navigation, Mandos
panel, three theme states (+ `prefers-color-scheme` without `data-theme`),
persistence, **localStorage throwing** (app still renders and toggles), no
horizontal body scroll at 640 px, the fragment rendered inside a host-like
skeleton (title, view, `var(--bg)` beating the host reset), zero console/page
errors. Screenshots in `out/<edition>/shots/`.

## How to run

```bash
cd app
pnpm install                 # (npm install also works; lockfile is pnpm's)

npm run dev                  # Vite dev server, VITE_EDITION=interno by default
VITE_EDITION=externo npm run dev

npm run build                # tsc -b (app + node + test configs) && vite build → dist-vite/
npm run typecheck            # tsc -b only
npm run test:format          # tsx test/format.test.ts

npm run build:bundle         # skill's bundle-artifact.sh → bundle.html (+ dist/index.html, dist/app.*.js/css)
npm run build:fragment       # bundle.html → dist/fragment.html (+ dist/fragment.report.json, out/<edition>/)
npm run build:all            # both, current VITE_EDITION (default interno)
npm run build:interno        # rm .parcel-cache + VITE_EDITION=interno build:all → out/interno/
npm run build:externo        # … → out/externo/
npm run build:editions       # interno + externo + check:exclusion
npm run check:exclusion      # asserts marker in out/interno/*, absent in out/externo/*
npm run smoke                # Playwright smoke on both editions (needs global playwright + browsers)
```

`build:bundle` resolves the skill script at
`${WEB_ARTIFACTS_SKILL:-/mnt/skills/examples/web-artifacts-builder}/scripts/bundle-artifact.sh`.
That script re-runs `pnpm add -D parcel …` and `rm -rf dist bundle.html` on every
call (by design), so `dist/fragment.html` is always the **last built edition**;
use `out/<edition>/fragment.html` when you need both side by side.

**Publishing**: give the Artifact tool `dist/fragment.html` (or `out/<edition>/fragment.html`)
as `file_path`. It already starts with `<title>` (the publisher reads the title from
the first 8 KB) and contains no doctype/html/head/body/meta.

### Design tokens (`src/styles/tokens.css`) and Tailwind names

All specified tokens are defined on bare `:root` (light, `color-scheme: light`), then
redefined under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) }`
and again under `:root[data-theme="dark"]` (both `color-scheme: dark`). No color exists
only inside a media/data-theme block.

| Token | Tailwind utility | Token | Tailwind utility |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `bg-bg` | `--accent` / `--accent-soft` | `text-accent` / `bg-accent-soft` |
| `--surface` / `--surface-2` | `bg-surface` / `bg-surface-2` | `--ok` `--risk` `--info` | `text-ok` `text-risk` `text-info` |
| `--hairline` | `border-hairline` | `--warn-text` / `--warn-fill` | `text-warn-text` / `bg-warn-fill` |
| `--ink` `--ink-2` `--ink-3` | `text-ink` `text-ink-2` `text-ink-3` | `--c-conservador/base/favorable` | `stroke-c-base` … |
| `--cat-1..3` | `fill-cat-1` … | `--radius-1/2`, `--shadow-1` | `rounded-1`/`rounded-2`, `shadow-1` |
| `--font-sans/serif/mono` | `font-sans` `font-serif` `font-mono` | `--space-1..8` | (Tailwind's 4-px scale already matches) |

Dash patterns are plain tokens: `--dash-conservador: 6 3`, `--dash-base: 0`,
`--dash-favorable: 2 3` → use `style={{ strokeDasharray: "var(--dash-base)" }}`
(see `CaseSelector.tsx`). `CASES` in `lib/views.ts` carries `colorVar`/`dashVar` per case.

Opacity modifiers work on every token utility (`bg-accent/10`, `text-ink/60`): the
Tailwind config compiles them to `color-mix(in srgb, var(--token) N%, transparent)`.
`dark:` variants are available but rarely needed — the tokens already flip.
`.num` utility = tabular numerals, right aligned. Body: IBM Plex Sans 14 px,
`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, `background: var(--bg)` explicit.

shadcn variables (`--background --foreground --card --popover --primary --secondary
--muted --destructive --border --input --ring --radius`) are mapped to tokens in
`src/index.css` (full colors, not HSL triplets), so kept components restyle themselves.

### Formatting (`src/lib/format.ts`) — no `Intl`

`fmtNum(x, d=0, sign)` → `1.234.567,89` · `fmtPct(fraction, d=2)` → `8,80 %` (U+2009 thin
space) · `fmtX` → `0,83x` · `fmtYears` → `7,4 años` · `fmtUSD` → `$ 214.690` /
`−$ 196.736` (U+2212, sign before `$`) · `fmtCompact` → `214,7 k` / `4,12 M` (2 decimals
below 10, else 1; rounds up a unit at 1.000) · `fmtUSDCompact` → `$ 4,12 M` · `fmtPP` →
`+1,8 pp` / `−1,2 pp` (zero unsigned) · `fmtSigned` · `formatNumber(x, {decimals, sign, empty})`
· `fmtDate(Date | ISO string | Excel serial)` → `08-sep-2026` · `fmtMonthYear` → `sep-2026`
· `roundTo` (half away from zero, no `toFixed` artefacts) · `excelSerialToDate`.
Non-finite/null → `—`. Note `fmtPct` takes a **fraction** (Excel cell semantics).
The thin space is breakable: wrap numbers in `whitespace-nowrap`/`.num` when needed.

### Edition split (`src/lib/edition.ts`)

`VITE_EDITION=interno|externo` (default interno) is read in code as the build-time
constant **`process.env.VITE_EDITION`** — replaced by Vite (`define`, and injected as a
global by `/@vite/env` in dev) and inlined natively by Parcel. `EDITION`, `isInterno()`,
`isExterno()`. Internal-only code lives in `src/internal/` and is referenced only behind
`process.env.VITE_EDITION !== "externo"`; in the externo build the condition folds to
`false`, the import is unused and both bundlers drop the module. `npm run check:exclusion`
enforces it after every `build:editions`. The shell exposes `data-edition` and (interno only)
`data-internal-marker` on its root `<div>`.

## Deviations from the instructions (and why)

1. **React 19.2 / TS 6.0 / Vite 8.2 instead of "React 18"** — the skill's `init-artifact.sh`
   runs `pnpm create vite … --template react-ts` at latest; kept as generated (Radix,
   cmdk, lucide all support React 19). Type-checked with zero errors.
2. **`baseUrl` removed from tsconfigs** — TS 6.0 makes it a hard error (TS5101). `paths`
   alone resolves `@/*`. Consequence: `parcel-resolver-tspaths` (which needs `baseUrl`) is
   not used; `.parcelrc` is just `{"extends": "@parcel/config-default"}` because Parcel ≥ 2.9
   resolves tsconfig `paths` natively. The package stays installed (the skill's bundle script
   re-adds it on every run anyway).
3. **`"@parcel/resolver-default": { "packageExports": true }`** in package.json — Radix
   1.1.x imports `@radix-ui/primitive/is-development`, an `exports` subpath Parcel ignores
   unless this flag is on.
4. **Google Fonts `<link>` is not written statically in `index.html`** — `html-inline`
   (the skill's inliner) tries to read every `link[href]` as a local file and aborts on an
   external URL. The single URL lives in `scripts/fonts.mjs`; `vite.config.ts` injects the
   `<link>` in dev/`vite build` (`transformIndexHtml`) and `to-fragment.mjs` injects it in
   the fragment right after `<title>`. The fragment still carries exactly one Google Fonts
   `<link>` with `display=swap`; `index.html` has a comment pointing to this.
5. **`process.env.VITE_EDITION` instead of `import.meta.env.VITE_EDITION`** — Parcel does
   not implement `import.meta.env`; `process.env.X` is the only expression both bundlers
   replace statically and dead-branch-eliminate. Same env variable name.
6. **Static import + build-time constant, not a guarded dynamic `import()`** — a dynamic
   import makes Parcel emit a separate async bundle loaded by URL, which the single-file
   artifact cannot serve (CSP blocks every host) — the interno edition would silently
   degrade. The guarded static reference is physically removed by both bundlers (verified).
7. **Two extra tokens**: `--on-accent` (text on accent: `#FFFFFF` / `#0F1216`) and
   `--surface-hover` (hover/selected wash, ink at 6–7 %). Needed to map shadcn's
   `--primary-foreground` and its `accent` hover semantic without clashing with the
   spec's `--accent` (tinta). Kept shadcn components were edited: `bg-accent
   text-accent-foreground` → `bg-surface-hover text-ink`; Button gained `xs`/`icon-xs`
   sizes; Tabs restyled as a hairline segmented control; `CommandDialog` renders an
   sr-only `DialogTitle`/`DialogDescription` (Radix a11y requirement).
8. **Vite `build.outDir = dist-vite`** — Parcel and the fragment own `dist/`; `npm run build`
   must not clobber them.
9. **«Mandos» is a non-modal `<aside>` in the CSS grid** (third column ≥ md; overlay < md)
   rather than a shadcn `Sheet` — an analyst adjusting controls should keep seeing the
   numbers; the instructions allowed either. `sheet.tsx` is kept in `ui/` as requested.
10. **`<meta>` tags are dropped from the fragment** — the publisher's skeleton already adds
    charset and viewport; the instruction list of what to keep does not include them.
11. **Extras**: `tsconfig.test.json` so `tsc -b` also type-checks the test; `out/<edition>/`
    copies so both editions coexist; `scripts/smoke.mjs` (optional Playwright); an edition
    badge in the top bar; the ⌘K palette actually navigates (still a placeholder for actions);
    the case selection is also kept in the hash (`c=`), so deep links carry view + case.
12. **Fragment size target is a warning, not a failure** ("target < 1.5 MB"); the CSP check is
    a hard failure as instructed. Override with `FRAGMENT_TARGET_BYTES`.

## Known warnings (harmless)

- Parcel: "redundant plugins: autoprefixer" — Parcel prefixes via lightningcss; autoprefixer
  stays in `postcss.config.js` for Vite.
- pnpm: "Ignored build scripts: @swc/core, lmdb, …" — prebuilt binaries are used; builds work.
- Parcel/lightningcss rewrites `rgba(42,91,215,.12)` as `#2a5bd71f` (8-digit hex), fine for
  the declared browserslist (last 2 versions of Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari/iOS).
- IBM Plex is not embedded (it loads from Google Fonts at runtime); headless screenshots
  taken offline show the system fallback stack.

## Handover pointers for F4 (views) and the engine

- Add a view: create the component, switch on `view` in `App.tsx` (replace `ViewPlaceholder`).
  Ids/labels/groups live in `lib/views.ts`; do not rename ids (they are URL state).
- Case state: `useHashNav().caseId` / `setCase`; the engine agent can subscribe there.
- Self-check chip: `<SelfCheckChip status="ok" passed={n} total={m} />` once the engine reports.
- Charts: `d3-scale`/`d3-shape`/`d3-array` are installed; use `--c-*` + `--dash-*` for the
  ordinal cases, `--accent` for Custom, `--cat-1..3` for ≤ 3-series comparisons.
- Internal-only content: put it under `src/internal/` and reference it only behind
  `process.env.VITE_EDITION !== "externo"`; then run `npm run build:editions`.
